zh.title: 星宇航空首條歐洲航線開通臺北－布拉格航班
zh.summary: 星宇航空於8月1日啟動首條歐洲航線，開航臺北桃園至布拉格航班，由董事長張國煒親自執飛。航線初期使用A350-900，9月起改用A350-1000，每週二、四、六飛航，10月起增至每週四班。
body: 星宇航空於8月1日正式啟動首條歐洲航線，開航桃園國際機場（TPE）至捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場（PRG）的直飛服務。這使星宇航空成為繼中華航空之後，第二家直飛捷克首都的臺灣航空公司。
星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛首航班機。依飛航追蹤資料，班機於當地時間凌晨12:50自臺北起飛，上午9:01抵達布拉格。星宇航空表示，航線初期每週二、四、六飛航三班，自2026年10月1日起增至每週四班；去程航班於凌晨12:10自臺北起飛、上午7:50抵達布拉格，回程航班於上午10:20自布拉格起飛，翌日上午5:10抵達臺北。
航線初期使用空中巴士A350-900客機，自9月1日起改用較大型的A350-1000，採四艙等、350個座位配置。布拉格目前是星宇航空唯一的歐洲航點，星宇航空也是臺北－布拉格航線唯一提供頭等艙的航空公司。
星宇航空執行長Glenn Chai表示，布拉格是公司長期航網發展的重要里程碑，市場需求包括臺灣與捷克半導體供應鏈帶動的商務旅行，以及兩地日益成長的觀光需求。他並表示，星宇航空將於近期開賣巴塞隆納航線機票；若正式開航，將成為首家提供臺灣直飛西班牙服務的航空公司。
巴塞隆納將成為星宇航空下一個歐洲航點。旅客經臺北樞紐轉機，可銜接日本、韓國、越南、泰國、馬來西亞、印尼、菲律賓及新加坡等亞洲目的地。布拉格機場董事會成員Martin Kučera表示，星宇航空選擇布拉格作為首個歐洲航點，反映該航空公司對雙方合作及布拉格機場吸引力的信心。

en.title: Starlux Airlines launches first European route with Taipei-Prague flight
en.summary: Starlux Airlines launched its first European route on August 1, 2026, with an inaugural Taipei-Prague flight piloted by Chairman K.W. Chang. The route initially operates with an A350-900 before switching to an A350-1000 on September 1, with three weekly flights increasing to four from October 1.
body: Starlux Airlines launched its first European route on August 1, 2026, with an inaugural flight between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) in Taipei and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG). This makes Starlux the second Taiwanese carrier to serve the Czech capital directly, following China Airlines.

Starlux Chairman K.W. Chang piloted the maiden flight himself, departing Taipei at 00:50 local time and landing in Prague at 09:01 local time, according to flight-tracking data. The airline said it will operate three round-trip flights per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, increasing to four weekly flights starting October 1, 2026. Regular outbound flights depart Taipei at 00:10 local time and arrive in Prague at 07:50, while return flights depart Prague at 10:20 local time and land in Taipei at 05:10 the following day.

The route will initially operate with an Airbus A350-900 before shifting to the larger A350-1000 starting September 1, 2026, a configuration that seats 350 passengers across four cabin classes. Prague is currently Starlux's only European destination, and the airline is the sole carrier offering First Class service on the Taipei-Prague route.

Starlux CEO Glenn Chai described Prague as an important milestone in the airline's long-term network development, citing growing business travel demand tied to expanding semiconductor supply chain ties between Taiwan and the Czech Republic, along with rising leisure travel between the two regions. Chai also announced that Starlux will soon begin selling tickets for a new route to Barcelona, which would make it the first Taiwanese airline to offer direct service to Spain.

Passengers connecting through Starlux's Taipei hub can reach a range of other Asian destinations the airline serves, including Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Singapore. Martin Kučera, a member of Prague Airport's Board of Directors, welcomed the new connection, saying the airline's choice of Prague as its first European destination reflects confidence in the airport's partnership and appeal.

zh.title: 威利華許正式接任印度航空巨頭IndiGo（印度靛藍航空）執行長
zh.summary: IndiGo（印度靛藍航空）於2026年8月3日發表聲明，歡迎威利華許正式就任執行長。華許曾任愛爾蘭航空、英國航空與國際航空集團執行長，以及國際航空運輸協會理事長。IndiGo表示，華許將負責營運管理與策略方向並加速國際擴張，接替於2025年12月離職的前執行長Pieter Elbers。
body: 印度最大航空公司IndiGo（印度靛藍航空）於2026年8月3日發表聲明，宣布威利華許（Willie Walsh）正式就任執行長。IndiGo先前於2026年3月首次宣布這項人事任命。華許表示，印度是全球成長最快速的航空市場之一，將為IndiGo帶來龐大發展機會。他指出，IndiGo在過去二十年間建立了良好基礎，並在短時間內躋身全球大型航空公司之列，現在正是加入公司的重要時刻。
IndiGo董事總經理Rahul Bhatia表示，隨著IndiGo邁入營運第三個十年並準備進入下一階段成長，他很高興正式歡迎華許加入。Bhatia指出，華許在全球航空業的豐富經驗，以及營運與策略專業，將在IndiGo加速推動國際擴張策略時發揮關鍵作用。
根據IndiGo聲明，華許擔任執行長後，將負責航空公司的整體管理與策略方向，重點包括加速全球成長、推動卓越營運、強化航網與商業策略，以及進一步提升顧客體驗。IndiGo期望借重華許的產業經驗與知識，帶領公司進入下一階段發展。

加入IndiGo之前，華許曾在愛爾蘭航空（Aer Lingus）擔任機師，並於2001年出任該公司執行長；2005年至2011年間擔任英國航空（British Airways）執行長，2011年至2020年間擔任國際航空集團（IAG）執行長，過去五年則擔任國際航空運輸協會（IATA）理事長。華許接任前，前執行長Pieter Elbers已於2025年12月離職；當時IndiGo因印度民航總局（DGCA）推行新版飛行任務時間限制（FDTL）規定，曾在數日內取消數千個航班。

en.title: Willie Walsh Begins First Day as IndiGo CEO to Lead Global Expansion
en.summary: IndiGo issued a statement on August 3, 2026, welcoming Willie Walsh as its new chief executive officer following an initial announcement in March 2026. Walsh brings extensive industry experience, having previously served as CEO of Aer Lingus, British Airways, and International Airlines Group, as well as director general of the International Air Transport Association. As CEO, Walsh will oversee overall management and strategic direction, focusing on international growth, operational excellence, and network strategy. He succeeds former CEO Pieter Elbers, who departed in December 2025 following flight disruptions related to regulatory changes.
body: Indian carrier IndiGo issued an official statement on August 3, 2026, welcoming Willie Walsh as its new chief executive officer. The announcement comes after the airline first revealed in March 2026 that Walsh would be joining the company. Commenting on his appointment, Walsh highlighted India's status as one of the world's fastest-growing aviation markets, stating that it presents immense opportunities for IndiGo. He added that the airline has established a remarkable legacy over the past two decades and noted that it is an exciting time to assume leadership.

Rahul Bhatia, Managing Director of IndiGo, expressed enthusiasm regarding Walsh's official arrival as CEO. Bhatia stated that as IndiGo enters its third decade and prepares for its next phase of growth, Walsh's extensive global experience in the aviation sector, combined with his operational and strategic expertise, will be instrumental in driving the airline's international expansion strategy.

According to IndiGo, Walsh will be responsible for overall management and strategic direction in his role as CEO. The company stated that his primary focus will encompass accelerating the airline's global growth trajectory, driving operational excellence, strengthening network and commercial strategies, and further enhancing the overall customer experience.

Walsh's background in aviation spans several decades, starting as a pilot at Aer Lingus before becoming CEO of the carrier in 2001. He subsequently served as CEO of British Airways from 2005 to 2011 and as CEO of International Airlines Group (IAG) between 2011 and 2020. For the past five years, he held the role of Director General at the International Air Transport Association (IATA). His appointment follows the departure of previous CEO Pieter Elbers in December 2025, after IndiGo experienced significant flight cancellations linked to new Flight Duty Time Limitation rules introduced by India's Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
